header.cleanBody: Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, for each Contract Spirit you control, destroy an opposing 25000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. When this effect destroys, if it's the Attack Step, you can either summon one of your "Top Buddy, Aibou" that is in Soul State/pre-advent condition, or [Advent] a Red "Sieg" from your Hand.
